pr_title: Fix crash when freeing GradientTexture and NoiseTexture
pr_body:
* The crash was directly caused by `RID_Alloc` calling destructor for uninitialized elements.
    * The backtrace of original issues show godot crashed at a different place for a different reason, that was covered by #49520.
* No range validation are performed when setting texture size, thus the uninitialized element, resulting in leaked RID allocations at exit.

Fixes #49569.
Fixes #49563.

review_comments:
About this change, @reduz said:
```
technically this situation should never happen so, while the fix is correct, I wonder what is causing it 
```

`RID_Alloc::allocate_rid()` and `RID_Alloc::initialize_rid()` are two APIs, so this situation will happen if only the former is called.

In this case, the `initialize_rid()` inside `RendererStorageRD::texture_2d_initialize()` will be skipped if `ERR_FAIL_COND` is triggered. No error handling can be done in `texture_2d_create()` (the `FUNCRIDTEX1` macro).

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/7a85e95a4b699960c540bb583cec526ab1b034d8/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/renderer_storage_rd.cpp#L543-L551

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/7a85e95a4b699960c540bb583cec526ab1b034d8/servers/rendering/rendering_server_default.h#L156-L165

The parameter range validations in this PR are added to prevent this error condition from happening.
